lines.beaver_en: Did you have a good Seollal? What did you do?
lines.en: Yes, I did the New Year's bow at my grandma's.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, did you get New Year's money too?
lines.learner: 네, 만 원짜리 세 장 받았어요.
lines.roman: ne, man wonjjari se jang badasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Lucky you! Did anything else happen?
Haha, you didn't get hurt? Did you have a feast too?
lines.learner: 네, 가족들이 다 모여서 잔치를 했어요.
lines.en: Yes, the whole family got together for a feast.
lines.roman: ne, gajokdeuri da moyeoseo janchireul haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: There must have been lots of food.
lines.learner: 네, 너무 많이 먹어서 배가 터질 뻔했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I ate so much I almost burst.
lines.roman: ne, neomu mani meogeoseo baega teojil ppeonhaesseoyo.

lines.en: Last week I went to a friend's housewarming party.
I bought a bouquet, but I almost left it behind.

lines.beaver_en: Did you get an invitation card too?
lines.en: Yes, but I almost mixed up the date.
Yes, we played games and I almost missed the last train.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, sounds like it was fun!
lines.learner: 네, 다음엔 우리 집에도 놀러 오세요!
lines.en: Yes, come over to my place next time too!
lines.roman: ne, daeumen uri jibedo nolleo oseyo!
